posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Mint.  I brought out an energy bracer, even knowing the risk, and a bloodsworn grabbed Seeker.  So I killed him, and then Haka punched Tempest and claimed it for the heroes.  Temepst got Living Weapon.  CC got Deathcaller when he sacced a construct, and I actually used it in the last round killing a bloodsworn.  Bloodsworn had 18 favor at the end - an unlucky Fickle Fans very nearly cost me this, but fortunately a well timed Ground Pound kept them from gaining any more favor, except for one from the Hivemind.  AA got Chaos Lord on the last turn, although at that point it was pretty useless.

 

> I didn't know that it was made so that chos lord was supposed to go under kaargra but I managed to avoid it by having CC destroy most of his own constructs after the round he played them which triggered a title being played so I guess I got lucky there but it also hlped that Tempest was able to get death caller with flash flood later as well.

I wouldn't say that it was made for Kaargra to grab Chaos Lord.  The rate at which titles come out is extremely dependant on what the heroes do and what targets they destroy.  I would say that Kaargra getting Chaos Lord with Bloodsworn Judgement isn't particularly more likely than her getting any other title.

posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked: Mint but it was a nail biter.  Turn before the first Fickle Fans heroes were winning 6-5.  Then Obsidean Field and Fickle Fans hit and by the end of Kaagra's turn it was 19-2 (AA earned unbreakable, Kaarga was an indicriminate seeker). The heroes lanched an epic comeback lead by Living Weapon Tempest with out of turn power use from AA.  Haka's plan was to ground pound but when Stone Jaw came out after AA had already used his power the only way to pull out the win was to have Haka use Taiha on an Energy Bracer to trigger Sustained Influence.  By the villain turn it was 17-19 villains lead and when the second Fickle Fans hit the heroes went up 22-14.  That was the final score as Tempest dealt the killing blow on AA's turn in what may have been one of the most epic Sentinels games I've ever played.

posts.name: robb8888
posts.cooked:
Reverend Pete:

Whew.This one took me three tries.  The second Fickle Fans ruined my first attempt…

 

Same here – the second Fickle Fans killed it.  I was ahead 23 favor points to 18, Haka had just played Ground Pound, my heroes had plenty of health (around 7-9 HP apiece), and I had more than enough damage readied to put Kaargra into the ground the next round.  None of the gladiators who give out favor points were on the board, and there was no way Kaargra was going to pick up any favor points by whacking my heroes…except she played Fickle Fans, got her 20 favor points instantly, and I died without firing a shot.  

 

I think Kaargra is my most frustrating villain for that reason:  No other villain's deck makes blind luck as big of a factor.    I've played about 10-20 matches against Kaargra, and have never lost by her incapping all of my heroes.  If she beats me, it's always because of the favor points mechanism, and usually either because of a last-minute Fickle Fans, or because she gets some crazy opening draw that starts her off at 10+ favor points before I've had a chance to do anything.

posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
Kaargra's deck isn't set up to incap the heroes, so that's not surprising.  Given that your goal isn't to defeat the Bloodsworn either, it makes sense that the deck is set up to gain titles and win the favor of the crowd instead.

 

Regarding blind luck, wait until we get Wager Master.   I'm really looking forward to his Weekly One-Shot, even if it's a random one (as that would actually be appropriate for him).

posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
It makes sense, though -- a blood crazed crowd isn't going to care about strategy and finesse, they wanna see people get stomped.

It's one of the things I both love and don't love about this game -- that characters, villains and environments will have cards and such that are thematically appropriate, but not necessarily mechanically optimal.
